spans.s:
गौपत्य गौपत्य, अम्, n. (fr. गो-पति), Ved.
the possession of cattle.

गौपवन, a patronymic from Gopa-vana; (अम्),
n., N. of a Sāman.
गौपायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Gopa.

गौपिक, अस्, m. (fr. गोपिका), the son of a herds-
man's wife.

गौपुच्छ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. गो-पुच्छ), like a
cow's tail.

गौपुच्छिक, अस्, ई, अम्, of or belonging to a
cow's tail, bought for a cow's tail &c.
